source.name: Protected circular-explanation holdout
source.notes: Independent synthetic passages drafted before development inspection; reviewed against the accepted taxonomy. Other checks remain unassessed.

instructions: Protected holdout: keep passages, labels, and snippets out of prompt-development contexts. Evaluate only after the candidate, prompts, model, thresholds, execution settings, and acceptance criteria are frozen. Return aggregate evaluation results to prompt authors.
